### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines? 



### 1.0 Package requirements

```{r}

setwd("/camp/lab/luscomben/home/users/palk/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis")

```


- Include required packages and functions

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("stringr")

require("RcolorBrewer")
require("stringr")


```

- Set paths

```{r}

analysis_path <- "02-differential-expression-profiling"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "input_files")

```


- Load the candidate gene selection from previous steps


```{r}

candidate_genes_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-significantly-affected-genes-by-kd-in-als-vs-control.rds"))

```

### 1.0 What is the cumulative effect of ERAP2 KD

- Reform data frame to make groups from columns 


```{r}

plot_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(candidate_genes_df)), function(x){
        temp_df <- candidate_genes_df[x,]
        new_df <- temp_df[,c(2,4,5,6)]
        new_quant_df <- data.frame(group = c(1, 2, 3), 
                value = c(temp_df$logfc, temp_df$kd_effect_lfc, temp_df$als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_lfc))
        new_quant_df$direction <- ifelse(new_quant_df$value < 0, "down", "up")
        return(cbind(new_df, new_quant_df))
}))


```

- Make two sample gene-set enrichment plots


```{r}

Breaks <- c(1, 2, 3)
Labels <- c("ALS vs Control", "ERAP2 KD effect in ALS", "ERAP2 KD effect on ALS vs Control")


Colours <- c("up" = "#D81E5B", "down" = "#3993DD")
the_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = value))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_line(shape = 21, colour = "#F7F7F9", aes(group = gene_ids))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "#000000", aes(fill = direction))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_violin(aes(group = group), fill = "#EAE6E5", colour = "#000000", 
        lwd = 0.5, alpha = 0.4)
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_boxplot(aes(group = group), fill = "#EAE6E5", colour = "#000000", 
        width = 0.1, lwd = 0.5, alpha = 0.4, outlier.size = NA, outlier.shape = NA)
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_x_continuous("Comparisons", breaks = Breaks, labels = Labels)
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_y_continuous("log2 fold change")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_fill_manual("lfc direction", values = Colours)
the_plot <- the_plot + theme_bw()
the_plot <- the_plot + theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1, angle = 45),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed", size = 0.2))
ggsave(the_plot, file = file.path(plot_dir, "08-summary-plot-showing-amelioration-of-ERAP2-phenotype.pdf"), height = 7, width = 7)


```
